headline: What Is Going on with Taiwan Semiconductor Stock on Wednesday?
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) stock slides despite raising its capex budget to expand 3nm and 2nm production ahead of schedule.

headline: Broadcom, Marvell And Nvidia Could Feel the Impact of US Ban on Chinese AI Components
summary: BNP Paribas warns a proposed U.S. ban on Chinese AI components could disrupt Broadcom, Marvell and Nvidia while driving up costs.
